thread:
maya: starting customer-theta adapter bring-up. LoRA merge landed in PR #894, need quick compatibility + quantization sanity before we hand to cs. attaching eval pack link. cc @anton @rachel @joon :wave:
anton: saw the PR. main concern is KV cache mismatch with model-x-8k vs customer checkpoint. did you run kv-shape check?
maya: ran shape check: looks OK for seq=2048 but failing for 8192. paste logs: ```KV shape mismatch: expected (12, 8, 2048) got (12, 8, 8192)```
joon: that's the 8k positional embedding overlap. quick fix: use `trim_pos_embed.py --target 8k`? but need to verify attention biases.
rachel: also we should run 4-bit q4f16 profile — customer wants smaller footprint. I'm running a smoke eval with the quickpack now.
eval-bot: started run quickpack/theta/merge-smoke on model: merged-theta-merged-v1, checkpoint ts:1764999000, status: queued
anton: FYI when merging LoRA, use `merge --no-rescale` for this adapter — we saw rescale changes logits distribution.
maya: thanks. i'm re-merging with `--no-rescale` and pushing a new artifact to s3://redwood/theta/merged-v2.safetensors
eval-bot: run started: quickpack/theta/merge-smoke -> job 3421. ETA ~12m
joon: also run the unit prompts for customer-sensitive behavior. there's a failing case where model hallucinates invoice numbers.
maya: added prompt set `theta_invoice_set.json` to the eval pack. small failure on `invoice_total` slot — sending transcript.
rachel: we saw degraded rouge on summarization by -3.2 on short docs when q4f16 applied. can you compare q8_0 and q4f16 outputs side-by-side?
maya: putting outputs in the gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/theta-merge-outputs. next steps: if q4 too regressive, try q4_0 + act-order tweak.
anton: agree. also add a canary route in console to point a small % to merged-theta-merged-v2 for live sim.
maya: thanks all. will update PR and DM cs. closing once eval-bot reports pass. :thumbsup:
